name: list of pending hr not sign employee contract
query:
SELECT
    pa.name AS "Prospect ID:Link/Employee Contract:120",
    pa.email AS "Email:Data:200",
    pa.first_name AS "First Name::150",
    pa.last_name AS "Last Name::150",
    CASE
        WHEN ja.email_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'Responded'
        ELSE 'Not Responded'
    END AS "Response Status::150"
FROM
    `tabEmployee Contract` pa
LEFT JOIN
    `tabJob Applicant` ja
    ON LOWER(TRIM(pa.email)) = LOWER(TRIM(ja.email_id))
report_name: list of pending hr not sign employee contract
